usedFor: Pivotal Tracker holds the stories and Asana holds the tasks, so “New Story” becomes “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Story” in Pivotal Tracker, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: The action can set assignee, tags, dates and description, so each new story arrives as a filled-in task.

watchOut: “New Story” in Pivotal Tracker is polling, so tasks appear in Asana after a scheduled check.
